name: aiwander-cpc-toolbelt
description: AIwander CPC tools for Claude: Hands automation skills, optional Workflow / Manager / Voice guidance, and Cache path setup. Does not include Autonomous.

HANDS_HOME.title: Hands install home
HANDS_HOME.description: Directory that contains servers/hands.exe. Leave empty to resolve %LOCALAPPDATA%\AIWander\Hands at runtime (the current user's application-data directory plus AIWander/Hands when that variable is unset). Set this at install time so the stdio command can expand. Not uploaded.

CPC_ROOT.title: CPC install root (back-compat)
CPC_ROOT.description: Optional. Used as the Hands home only when HANDS_HOME is unset. Older installs can set CPC_ROOT or cpc_root instead of HANDS_HOME. Leave empty on a new install.

CPC_CACHE.title: Cache path
CPC_CACHE.description: Optional local Cache directory. When empty, Cache is <Hands home>/cache. Path plus skills only; no Cache MCP. Not uploaded.
